description: Xfce Terminal is a lightweight and easy to use terminal emulator application with many advanced features including drop down, tabs, unlimited scrolling, full colors, fonts, transparent backgrounds, and more.
notes:
This Terminal workspace extends the Kasm Terminal workspace as follows:
  - zsh as default
  - tmux with custom configuration
  - VPN sidecar support when the VPN network device is bound to x.x.x.2

If a network is selected where the x.x.x.2 address is a gateway, traffic will be routed through it. This allows a VPN to run as a container and be shared across containers.
